normalized.description: The Radar Observing System for Europe - L-Band (ROSE-L) is being developed by the European Space Agency (ESA) as one of the Copernicus Expansion (COPEX) missions, and will fill the need for L-band SAR data for Land Monitoring, Emergency Management, Marine Environment Monitoring and Security Services. One of ROSE-L objectives is to provide continuity of current observations in order to establish long and reliable time series of measurements. This includes, e.g., the provision of Level-2 Ocean data similar to the ones currently available for the Sentinel-1 mission. To support this goal, this activity aims to prototype and develop the ROSE-L L2 Ocean processor which will be deployed in the Copernicus Ground Segment. The activity will be divided in two phases. The first phase is dedicated to the consolidation of algorithms and product performances, definition of the calibration and validation approach and prototyping activities. The second phase is mainly dedicated to the evolution of the prototype into the operational processor, and it also includes the consolidation of cal/val approach, and support to the integration in the ground segment.
